method.preparation: The parent introduced deliberate local code changes and retained a separate answer key.

method.freeze: Independent JSON was archived before answer-key comparison.
method.scoring: Match frozen finding locations to seeded root-control spans.
method.isolation_limit: Context separation and task restrictions, not OS-enforced filesystem isolation.
